    • COOKIE_PARTITIONED_ATTR

      public static final String COOKIE_PARTITIONED_ATTR
      The name of the attribute used to indicate a partitioned cookie as part of CHIPS. This cookie attribute is not defined by an RFC and may change in a non-backwards compatible way once equivalent functionality is included in an RFC.

      public static final String SESS_PASSWORD_NOTE
      If the cache property of the authenticator is set, and the current request is part of a session, the password used to authenticate this user will be cached under this key to avoid the need for repeated calls to Realm.authenticate().
